title: 2011年东北地震 · 六站真实记录
subtitle: BHZ垂直通道 · 20 Hz原始计数 · 1秒窗包络
description: 沿同一UTC时间窗，查看日本、韩国、台湾、萨哈林、关岛与蒙古六个真实台站记录到的不同波形。信号来自官方档案，未生成理论波纹。

stations.valueMeaning: Actual signed sample with greatest absolute baseline-subtracted count in the preceding one-second window.

baselineWindow.method: median of actual raw counts before earthquake origin

stations.normalization: Independent per-station display scale only. Do not compare counts or normalized amplitudes between instruments.

channelMetadata.note: Sensitivity metadata is retained but not applied; output remains instrument counts.

processing.kind: derived envelopes from observed digital waveform samples
processing.baseline: station-specific median during 05:45:00 <= UTC < 05:46:00, before origin
processing.timeUtcMeaning: exclusive window end; all source samples precede the displayed clock
processing.value: signed actual sample with largest absolute baseline-subtracted count; peakTimeUtc/rawValue/sourceLine retain its exact origin
processing.minMax: actual minimum and maximum native samples in the same one-second window, with the same baseline removed
processing.missingPolicy: empty window null; partially populated windows retain actual sampleCount/status; no filling or interpolation
processing.display: normalize each station independently; marker size is an explanatory scale, not geographic displacement, shaking intensity or affected area

limitations: 数值为数字仪器计数counts，已减去震前一分钟中位数；未校正完整仪器响应，不是cm/s、m/s、加速度或地表位移。
各站仪器灵敏度不同；图形只能按各站独立尺度读取，不能用计数大小或归一化图形比较不同地区的实际震动强弱。
每个时钟点代表刚结束的一秒窗，值为其中一个实际峰值样本，阴影范围为真实最小—最大值；不是1 Hz原始连续采样。
仅BHZ垂直通道、六个选定台站；不是完整观测网或当地烈度图。未自动识别P/S到时，不据波形标签推断相位或震源机制。
仪器可能含基线漂移、长周期响应或削波；本版未完成专业仪器质量评估。负值表示通道计数相对基线的符号，不能直接解释为地表上下位移。
地球上的径向针柱或圈只编码该站该窗信号，视觉大小经过放大，不是实测传播波前、影响范围或地表形变。
